items.name: Chunxi Road
items.note: Chengdu's best-known shopping street, from department stores to snack stalls. Go after dark for the lights; IFS and Taikoo Li are at its east end.

items.name: Chengdu IFS
items.th: เฉิงตูกั๋วจี้จินหรงจงซิน
items.photoCredit: David Xuang · CC BY-SA 4.0 (statue by Lawrence Argent)
items.note: High-end mall with international brands and the giant panda on its wall. Tax refunds on the spot for overseas visitors.
tags: Metro Chunxi Road exit C or D

items.name: Taikoo Li
items.th: เฉิงตูไท่กู่หลี่
items.note: Open-air lanes of low Sichuan-style buildings beside Daci Temple: designer brands, cafés and lifestyle stores. It joins IFS across the road.

items.name: Chengdu SKP
items.th: เฉิงตู เอสเคพี
items.note: Luxury mall for fashion, beauty and jewellery, not souvenirs. It is 11 km south of the hotel, so go only for luxury shopping.

items.name: Kuanzhai Alley shops
items.th: ควานไจ่เซี่ยงจึ
items.note: The souvenir stop closest to the hotel: tea, panda goods, handicrafts and Sichuan snacks, mostly ¥15–120. Shops just outside the lanes are cheaper.

items.name: Hotpot base and Sichuan pepper
items.th: อีเถิงหยางหัวถัง (ซวงหนานเตี้ยน)

ask.th: หั่วกัวตี่เลี่ยว · ฮวาเจียว

items.atSource: OSM way 336956609, 伊藤洋华堂双楠店 (WGS-84 → GCJ-02)
items.photoCredit: Breaknet2025 · CC BY 4.0 (photo of a Chengdu hotpot, not the packet)
items.note: Supermarket hotpot base (beef-tallow, vegetable-oil, mushroom or tomato) and small sealed packs of Sichuan pepper, red or green.

items.name: Pixian chili bean paste
items.th: อีเถิงหยางหัวถัง (ซวงหนานเตี้ยน)

ask.th: ผีเซี่ยนโต้วป้าน

items.atSource: OSM way 336956609, 伊藤洋华堂双楠店 (WGS-84 → GCJ-02)
items.note: The broad-bean chili paste behind mapo tofu. Pick a factory-sealed tub with a printed expiry date.

items.name: Sichuan green tea
items.th: ต้าซีหนานฉาเฉิง

ask.th: เหมิงติ่งกันลู่ · จู๋เย่ชิง

items.atSource: No trustworthy point: not in OSM and no Ctrip page found. Sources place it at Wukuaishi (五块石), Jinniu district.
items.note: Chengdu's big tea market; taste before you buy. Loose "Zhuyeqing" is often fake, so buy it boxed.

items.name: Panda souvenirs
items.th: สยงเมาโหยวจวี๋

ask.th: สยงเมากงจ่าย

items.atSource: OSM node 12574196373, 熊猫邮局 (China Post), 熊猫大道1375号 (WGS-84 → GCJ-02)
items.photoCredit: 玄史生 · CC BY-SA 3.0 (panda toys in a hotel gift shop, not in Chengdu)
items.note: Licensed panda goods at the Panda Base shops and post office: plush toys, keychains, magnets, mugs and postcards. Kuanzhai Alley and Jinli sell the same.

items.name: Shu brocade
items.th: สู่จิ่นจือซิ่วป๋ออู้กว่าน
items.note: Chengdu's silk brocade as scarves, framed pieces, bags and fans. The Shu Brocade Museum, 1 km west of the hotel, is the safe place for genuine pieces.
